sources.snippet: The ltzheng/Qwen3.5-9B-General-Game model is a 9 billion parameter language model from the Qwen3.5 family, developed by ltzheng. It is specifically fine-tuned for general game applications, incorporating five unique training action/thought tokens to facilitate game-specific interactions.
